in_marathi.name: Jithu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jithu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jithu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jita', meaning 'victory' or 'success'. It is a name of great significance in Hindu culture, often given to children as a symbol of hope and triumph. The name is also associated with the god Vishnu, who is known for his power to grant victory and prosperity.
